title: Quick Chinese Pork Twice-Cooked-Pork
description: A quick-fix Chinese dish featuring pork, glace cherry, and a peppery sauce, served in a pillowy format, free from nuts, easy to prepare and cook, suitable for weeknights, and ideal for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet and saut	7 the garlic and ginger until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, hoisin sauce, and rice vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the browned pork back to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
In a small bowl, mix together the cornstarch and a small amount of water until smooth, then add to the skillet and stir to thicken the sauce.
Add the glace cherry to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the pork to the skillet and cook until the sauce has thickened and the pork is cooked through, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the pork to a serving platter and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
